title: Super Mario Galaxy: Gusty Garden Galaxy
alt: Small round worlds are in a bright blue sky above white clouds. A very small man in a red cap hangs from a white dandelion seed in the air. Below him a vine grows from a round grass world with flowers, a tree and a white rabbit. On the right are a red, a green and a yellow apple as large as worlds, and a green caterpillar makes a bridge between two of them.
summary: A painting of Gusty Garden Galaxy from Super Mario Galaxy in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Gusty Garden Galaxy from Super Mario Galaxy, a game by Nintendo. Small worlds are in a sky that is full of wind. Mario holds a Floaty Fluff and moves across the space between a grass world and three apple worlds.
A caterpillar makes a bridge from the red apple to the green apple. Star Bits fall through the sky. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
